msg: Case statement is not terminated by a break!
reasoning: TRUE POSITIVE (NEW): 061fd0a353e.c (BusyBox hdparm). 'Case statement not terminated by break' at lines 26-27 when CONFIG_FEATURE_HDPARM_HDIO_SCAN_HWIF is defined. Case 'R' (line 26) genuinely lacks a break: after 'if(!p) goto expected_hwif_error', the code falls through directly to the expected_hwif_error: label and printf — so case 'R' always prints the error message even when p is valid. The //ERROR comment in this file marks line 21 (goto in case 'U'), suggesting the known vbdb bug is the goto to a conditionally-compiled label (PULSE_UNINITIALIZED_VALUE on p). This case fall-through in case 'R' is a distinct NEW bug. CORRECTLY CONSTRAINED: only compiled when SCAN_HWIF=true.
